cases.question: What is the capital city of Pakistan? Return one short text value.
Which World Bank region contains Pakistan? Return the official World Bank label.
cases.expected: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

cases.question: What is the World Bank income level of Pakistan? Return the official label.
List every country in the World Bank region 'South Asia'. Return a JSON list of country names with no explanation.
Using the rule 'same World Bank region and same income level', list every country similar to Pakistan. Return a JSON list of country names with no explanation.

Using weights region=0.30, income=0.25, GDP-per-capita=0.20, life-expectancy=0.15, population=0.10, list the top three countries most similar to Pakistan. Return a JSON list of country names with no explanation.
List every represented country with population at least 100000000. Return a JSON list of country names with no explanation.
For each income group, compute average life expectancy and select countries at least 3.0 years above their group average. Return the first five country names ranked by absolute difference.
What is the latest population value for Pakistan? Return only a number.
What is the latest GDP per capita in current US dollars for Pakistan? Return only a number.
